The **Comparative Result** topic encompasses key performance and clinical outcome metrics evaluated across different anticoagulant therapies and Danish healthcare regions. These comparisons are critical for assessing the quality of care, specifically regarding stroke prevention and bleeding risks in patients, as well as regional adherence to clinical development targets.

In terms of pharmacological comparisons, the data evaluates the clinical outcomes of [[DOAC]] versus [[marevan]]. For [[Indikator 5]], the proportion of patients experiencing ischemic stroke is 0.89% for DOAC and 0.51% for marevan [^src1]. Conversely, when examining the risk of [[Alvorlig blødning|severe bleeding]], the rate is slightly lower for DOAC at 2.40% compared to 2.54% for marevan [^src3]. 

Geographical and organizational performance metrics highlight significant disparities across Denmark's regions and health clusters. Regarding regional development targets, three regions—[[Region Nordjylland|Nordjylland]], [[Region Midtjylland|Midtjylland]], and [[Region Syddanmark|Syddanmark]]—successfully meet the goal, whereas [[Region Sjælland|Sjælland]] and [[Region Hovedstaden|Hovedstaden]] fall above the development target [^src2]. 

For [[Indikator 8]] in the 2023/24 period, [[Region Syddanmark|Syddanmark]] records the highest proportion among the regions at 20.3% (95% CI: 19.1–21.6) [^src4], while [[Region Sjælland|Sjælland]] has the lowest at 4.3% (95% CI: 3.6–5.0) [^src4]. At the health cluster level, [[Midtklyngen]] stands out as the only cluster meeting the ≥50% objective, achieving 62.1% (95% CI: 58.8–65.3) [^src4]. In stark contrast, [[Sundhedsklyngen SUH]] reports the lowest proportion among all clusters at just 0.1% (95% CI: 0.0–0.5) [^src4].
